receipt.public_excerpt: We analyzed 900,000 newly created web pages in April 2025 and found that 74.2% of them contained AI-generated content.

evidence_items.explanation: Shows AI-generated content was present in most new web pages in April 2025. This supports 'widespread'. Caveats: the measurement uses Ahrefs' own detector, and most pages were mixed human-and-AI rather than pure AI.

receipt.public_excerpt: 20,000 completely AI-generated tracks are added to its music service on a daily basis, making up "over 18% of all uploaded content" the platform receives every day.

evidence_items.explanation: Shows that fully AI-generated tracks were a large and growing share of music uploads in a second domain. The same article says Spotify faces the same issue.

receipt.public_excerpt: Damien's database has 116 cases from 12 different countries

evidence_items.explanation: Records court decisions in 12 countries confirming that AI-hallucinated content was submitted in legal filings. This is documented harm in law, a third domain. The post also notes that 20 of the cases came in May 2025 alone.

unresolved_gaps: 'Serious' has no agreed measure. The verdict rests on documented harms, not on any severity threshold.
The Ahrefs figure counts mixed AI-assisted content, which is not necessarily low quality. The Ahrefs and Deezer figures both come from the companies' own detectors.
No measurement was cited for politics, journalism or education, which the post also names.
